title: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules, versions 6.0.0 through 10.0.3, contains an Improper Neutralization of Special…
description: Dell OpenManage Ansible Modules versions 6.0.0 through 10.0.3 contain an XML injection vulnerability due to improper neutralization of special elements in the XML data conversion component. A low privileged attacker with remote access could exploit this flaw to inject malicious XML content, potentially causing XML parsing errors and impacting system integrity.
